title: Monster Hunter Diamond Tools ⚔️
description: Changes diamond tools to be perfect for hunting vampires and monsters alike.
body:
# Diamond Tools -> ⚔️ Monster Hunter Tools ⚔️

A Minecraft resourcepack to make your diamond tools look perfect for slaying vampires and monsters alike.

Silver tools and wooden stakes, all a real hunter needs.

### Description;

A resourcepack that changes diamond tools to be visually made for slaying beasts.
![Textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/123e749ddb28c143fe624d45715a8e128d8a5631.png)


### Other Info;

Dependencies-

No hard mod requirements.

No soft mod requirements.


Version-

Revision 0 - Minecraft 26.1+

My packs are default released for latest version of Minecraft- if you want it ported to a newer or older version let me know. _(*Done at my discretion. Some things may be too difficult to port.)_
